This maybe a nice tip if you get itchy eyes: A while ago I got in contact with something that set off a massive reaction on my eyes (really itchy, redness and the top layer over the white part seemed to crumple up if I looked to one side). My boss made me a cup of cold tea and told me to pour some in my eyes like you would do with eye drops. Almost instantly the itching went away and it didn't come back that day either. It was really soothing. They still stayed red because I'd been rubbing like a maniac, but at least it was at ease after that.

YMMV, but it's something easy you could try if you have a serious eye-itch. :)
